verdict.summary: The revised checker fails closed before full-manifest loading or worker creation when available host memory cannot preserve the 3 GiB reserve plus the measured 1.5 GiB startup allowance. At the actual invocation only 3.39 GiB was available versus the 4.5 GiB admission requirement, so the empty-trial failed_or_partial report is correct. This is an environmental execution blocker, not a demonstrated cache, shuffle, ordering or implementation defect. Workers 2/4 remain unverified on the full development datasets.

static_contract_review.device_boundary: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is cleared before torch is imported in run; loaders use pin_memory=false. No CUDA, model, loss, optimizer or checkpoint-write path exists in the checker.
static_contract_review.artifact_binding: A successful admitted run requires exact manifest, cache index, checkpoint, prior GPU benchmark and prior independent GPU-review receipts. DiskCachedDataset additionally checks the current preprocessing identity, every source/row/offset binding, blob size and blob SHA.
static_contract_review.development_only_gate: Declared rows are checked for train/val-only before load_dataset_manifest; no newtest split is allowed.
static_contract_review.full_dataset_constructors: An admitted run constructs raw and cache datasets independently for both the complete 19050-row train split and complete 5151-row val split.
static_contract_review.order_and_content: The workers-0 raw path supplies the baseline. Every later raw/cache worker configuration compares per-batch SHA-256 over pixels, boxes, labels, ignore boxes and keys, so both content and order are covered.
static_contract_review.augmentation_scope: Train epochs 6 and 7 use Mosaic; train epoch 285 explicitly disables Mosaic; val epoch 6 is unshuffled and non-Mosaic.
static_contract_review.prefetch_scope: The checker intentionally uses the full DataLoader with default prefetch_factor=2 to preserve real worker metadata and startup behavior. Background workers may therefore read additional development samples beyond the 64 or 16 consumed samples; the report explicitly disclaims a strict pixel-read cap.
static_contract_review.memory_protection: The checker requires 4.5 GiB available before the full-manifest startup, then applies per-worker admission estimates and a 0.25-second live 3 GiB reserve monitor over the diagnostic process tree.
static_contract_review.worker_cleanup: Bounded iterators explicitly call the private torch shutdown hook, retain the exact iterator worker handles, terminate/join only still-live owned handles in a finally fallback, and reject any surviving owned worker. Monitor errors are surfaced before a later DataLoader timeout can mask the memory cause.

actual_admission_result.error: MemoryError: full-manifest admission requires4.5 GiB available before loading
actual_admission_result.interpretation: The admission gate prevented the known high-memory full-manifest/spawn path before it could reduce available memory below the required reserve. No full-data worker parity or throughput conclusion can be drawn from this report.

independent_CPU_check.result: exit 0; 1 test passed and 1 test skipped in 0.144 seconds
independent_CPU_check.passed_scope: Memory threshold behavior, process-tree sampling, workers-0 ordered batch consumption and mismatch rejection.
independent_CPU_check.skipped_scope: The real Windows spawn workers-2/4 fixture requires at least 6 GiB available and was deliberately not started under current memory pressure.

earlier_spawn_attempt.result: A pre-fix tiny-fixture workers-2 attempt ended after the 120-second DataLoader timeout with worker exited unexpectedly.
not_valid_evidence_for: 3 GiB reserve violation as the unique cause

findings.evidence: The admitted minimum is 4.5 GiB, while the run observed 3.3914 GiB available. The shortfall was 1.1086 GiB.
findings.disposition: Do not lower the 3 GiB live reserve or force workers 2/4. Retry only when the required memory is genuinely available and retain the same pinned artifacts and exact cleanup checks.

findings.evidence: The earlier small spawned-worker attempt reported only the generic DataLoader worker exit after timeout; the revised cause-priority logic was not active for that attempt.
findings.disposition: Do not label that event an out-of-memory failure or a cache/order defect. A future admitted run must supply the first attributable monitor or loader failure.

findings.evidence: Even a future successful run consumes only 64 main epoch-6 samples and 16 samples in each smaller check, while default worker prefetch may read additional development samples.
findings.disposition: Report measured startup, first-batch, bounded wall time, RSS and ordering only. Do not claim a full epoch, exact 64-image pixel-read boundary, workers-4 training throughput, accuracy or GPU overlap.
